column7: Forwards the events fence read to the gateway; a stopped gateway answers busy, so a record is deferred, never read as unchanged.
The events fence: the mint-free read of the stable grant binding that a delivery compares and a listener run is fixed on; no view fences closed.
The one mint-free custody read behind the view and fence bindings: refuses a revoked or reconnect-required grant and one stored under another descriptor revision.
The fence binding of the lease a listener mint released, encoded as custody's read is, so a run's stamp and a delivery's read compare like with like.
Encodes the stable grant fields without the token revision, length-prefixed; a field left out would let a rotation pass the fence.
